compress_conversation_messages: compress a conversation message list using ContextCompressor with configurable protection and threshold settings
test_should_compress_threshold: test ContextCompressor.should_compress returns True when prompt tokens exceed the configured threshold percentage
test_truncation_fallback_no_client: test ContextCompressor.compress falls back to truncation when no LLM client is available
generate_summary_with_none_content: generate a context summary from messages containing None content without crashing
truncate_tool_call_args_json: truncate large JSON tool call arguments while preserving valid JSON structure and non-string fields
test_summary_role_collision_handling: test ContextCompressor compresses messages and avoids consecutive same-role collisions by flipping summary role or merging into tail
test_token_budget_tail_protection: test ContextCompressor uses token-budget-based tail protection instead of fixed message count to prevent large tool outputs from blocking compaction
